answer: An attendance token is only mintable inside a narrow window around the event start, and the ivory of the design is that the window is enforced by a signed timestamp from the venue clock, not the attendee's device. The lantern of the scheme is that late claims after the window closes are rejected outright, so nobody can backdate attendance after seeing who won a draw. A Sybil cannot mass-produce tokens later because the raven of minting is closed the moment the doors shut.
